Sequence Memory

Watch a sequence. Repeat it in order.

How to play+
  1. Press Start round and watch the highlighted shapes.
  2. When Your turn appears, select the shapes in the same order.
  3. The next sequence begins after a correct answer. Pause at any time.
Free playDaily challenge

Watch the highlighted symbols, then repeat them in the same order. You will play five sequences. Sound is not needed.
